item.title: Three including woman arrested at BIA with over 16 kg of Kush
item.description: Three individuals, including a woman, have been apprehended at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) by the Airport Police Narcotics Division in Wellampitiya while in possession of over 16 kilograms of Kush narcotics. MORE..

item.title: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva to arrive in Sri Lanka today
item.description: Kristalina Georgieva, Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), is scheduled to arrive in Sri Lanka today (16). MORE..

item.title: Parcel containing live ammunition, SIM cards recovered in Wattala
item.description: A parcel containing live ammunition has been taken into custody by the police in the Gaala Junction area in Wattala. MORE..

item.title: Leaders gather for New Delhi AI summit as warnings grow over societal risks
item.description: A global artificial intelligence summit kicks off in New Delhi on Monday with big issues on the agenda, from job disruption to child safety, but some attendees warn the broad focus could diminish the chance of concrete commitments from world leaders. MORE..

item.title: Tamil Nadu CM urges PM Modi to solve citizenship issues of 89,000 Sri Lankan Tamils
item.description: With just two months to go for the Tamil Nadu Assembly elections, Chief Minister MK Stalin has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi seeking a “humane and pragmatic” resolution to the long-pending citizenship issue and legal status of Sri Lankan Tamils living in the state for over four decades. MORE..

item.title: Women must step forward to carry forward the change we have begun - PM
item.description: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya stated that no one will be allowed to drag the country s future backward by inciting racism, and emphasized that women must step forward to carry forward the change that has been initiated. MORE..

item.title: President Dissanayake pays last respects to late Prof. Tissa Vitarana
item.description: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has paid his final respects to the late veteran politician and former minister, Professor Tissa Vitarana. MORE..

item.title: Train services on Colombo–Puttalam line resume following cyclone Ditwah disruptions
item.description: Train services on the Colombo–Puttalam railway line, which were suspended due to the damage caused by the Cyclone Ditwah, have resumed earlier this morning (16). MORE..

item.title: Case against Namal Rajapaksa over Krrish deal adjourned
item.description: The Colombo High Court has ordered the postponement of the case filed against Member of Parliament Namal Rajapaksa regarding the controversial Krrish project deal until February 19. MORE..

item.title: Special announcement for 2025 O'L exam candidates
item.description: The Commissioner General of Examinations, A. K. S. Indika Kumari Liyanage, has urged candidates sitting for the 2025 G.C.E. Ordinary Level (O'L) Examination to pay close attention to the official examination timetable. MORE..
